description: This file defines a Perl package 'DiffHighlight' that provides functions for syntax highlighting and processing diffs, including handling color sequences, highlighting pairs of lines, and managing diff hunks.

methods.name: visible_width
methods.description: Calculates the visible width of a string excluding terminal color sequences.

methods.name: visible_substr
methods.description: Returns a substring omitting a specified number of visible characters, ignoring color sequences.

methods.name: handle_line
methods.description: Processes a line of diff output, managing diff hunks and graph lines.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes queued diff hunks for highlighting.

methods.name: highlight_stdin
methods.description: Reads diff lines from STDIN and processes them.

methods.name: color_config
methods.description: Retrieves color configuration from git or returns default.

methods.name: show_hunk
methods.description: Highlights a diff hunk by comparing two sets of lines.

methods.name: highlight_pair
methods.description: Highlights differences between two lines, considering common prefixes and suffixes.

methods.name: split_line
methods.description: Splits a line into tokens, separating color sequences.

methods.name: highlight_line
methods.description: Highlights a segment of a line based on theme.

methods.name: is_pair_interesting
methods.description: Determines if a pair of lines has meaningful differences worth highlighting.
